circuit:
* Current-starved ring VCO, f ~ K*(vctrl - V0)
* - Banba bandgap current (PNP + ideal R) sets a PVT-stable offset V0 = Iinj*R1
* - Op-amp V-to-I: Ipass = (vctrl - V0)/R1, mirrored to the ring starve devices
* - 3 inverting stages: slow inverter -> fast inverter/NAND -> current-starved
*   inverter loaded by ideal C, so the period is ~3*C*VDD/I (threshold independent)
* - EN (from vctrl) holds the ring in a static state while vctrl is low

.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout

*** Op-amp bias: resistor-referenced NMOS diode
RB vdd nbias 600k
XMB0 nbias nbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XMB1 tail1 nbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XMB2 tail2 nbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1 m=2

*** Bandgap current reference (Banba, level-shifted op-amp inputs)
XPB1 va1 vbg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=2 nf=1
XPB2 vb1 vbg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=2 nf=1
RXA va1 va 100k
RXB vb1 vb 100k
XQ1 vss vss va sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68
R2A va vss 520k
* ~20 nA into va breaks the PNP-off neutral equilibrium (keeps va>vb there)
RSTA vdd va 50meg
RPT vb vq2 57k
XQ2 vss vss vq2 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68 m=8
R2B vb vss 520k
XN1A o1d vb1 tail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=4 nf=1
XN1B vbg va1 tail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=4 nf=1
XP1A o1d o1d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=2 nf=1
XP1B vbg o1d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=2 nf=1
CC1 vbg vdd 2p
* startup: pull vbg low while va1 is low
RST vdd st 5meg
XNS1 st va1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XNS2 vbg st vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.42 nf=1

*** V-to-I with offset: Ipass = vctrl/R1 - Iinj
XPINJ na vbg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=2 nf=1 m=2
R1 na vss 144k
XPPASS na g2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=4 nf=1
XN2A o2d na s2a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=4 nf=1
RS2A s2a tail2 50k
XN2B g2 vctrl s2b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=4 nf=1
RS2B s2b tail2 50k
XP2A o2d o2d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=4 nf=1
XP2B g2 o2d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=4 nf=1
CC2 g2 cz 0.2p
RZ cz na 50k

*** Ring bias chain (with replicas of the ring switches)

XNBD nbr nbr nbs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1

*** Enable: EN high once vctrl exceeds ~0.5 V (delayed by RC)
XPE1 enb vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=0.42 nf=1
XNE1 enb vctrl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
REN enb enbd 200k
CEN enbd vss 50f
XPE2 en enbd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

XPSW1 p1 y1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=6

XNST1 x1 nbr n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1 m=6
XNSW1 n1 y1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 m=6

*** Stage 2

circuit:
* Current-starved ring VCO (SKY130, 1.8 V devices, ideal R/C for bias and delay)
*
* Architecture
*  - V-to-I: vctrl drives source-degenerated NMOS XM1 (R1) into LVT PMOS diode XM2,
*    giving I1 ~ (vctrl - Vgs)/R. XMR, a long-channel NMOS in triode (gate at vdd)
*    in parallel with R1, cancels the V-to-I temperature drift: its conductance
*    falls with temperature (mobility) and rises with vdd.
*  - Bias: XM2 sets pb for the ring PMOS current sources (2.05x mirror);
*    XM3/XM4 mirror I1 to nb for the ring NMOS current sinks (2.05x mirror).
*  - Ring: 5 balanced current-starved stages with ideal node caps. Stage 1 is a
*    starved NAND gated by en.
*  - Enable/startup: en = buffered (vctrl > ~0.5 V). With en low (vctrl = 0),
*    reset devices hold n1..n5 at 1,0,1,0,1 and vout low. When vctrl steps up,
*    the first edge propagates immediately, so vout rises within about 50 ns.
*  - Output: non-inverting buffer from n2 into the 20 fF load; the first
*    inverter's N/P ratio centers the duty cycle.
.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout
* ---- V-to-I converter
XM1 pb vctrl s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
R1 s1 vss 67k
XMR s1 vdd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=0.5 nf=1
XM2 pb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=4 nf=1
* ---- mirror to NMOS sink bias
XM3 nb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=4 nf=1
XM4 nb nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
* ---- enable derived from vctrl (low-threshold inverter pair)
XE1P enb vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=0.42 nf=1
XE1N enb vctrl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XE2P en enb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XE2N en enb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 nf=1
* ---- stage 1: starved NAND (inputs n5, en) -> n1; reset high
XS1PC p1 pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8.2 nf=1
XS1NC q1 nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4.1 nf=1
XS1PA n1 n5 p1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XS1PB n1 en p1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XS1NA n1 n5 m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XS1NB m1 en q1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XS1R n1 en vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
C1 n1 vss 42f
* ---- stage 2: starved inverter n1 -> n2; reset low
XS2PC p2 pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8.2 nf=1
XS2NC q2 nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4.1 nf=1
XS2P n2 n1 p2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XS2N n2 n1 q2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XS2R n2 enb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
C2 n2 vss 42f
* ---- stage 3: starved inverter n2 -> n3; reset high
XS3PC p3 pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8.2 nf=1
XS3NC q3 nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4.1 nf=1
XS3P n3 n2 p3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XS3N n3 n2 q3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XS3R n3 en vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
C3 n3 vss 42f
* ---- stage 4: starved inverter n3 -> n4; reset low
XS4PC p4 pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8.2 nf=1
XS4NC q4 nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4.1 nf=1
XS4P n4 n3 p4 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XS4N n4 n3 q4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XS4R n4 enb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
C4 n4 vss 42f
* ---- stage 5: starved inverter n4 -> n5; reset high
XS5PC p5 pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8.2 nf=1
XS5NC q5 nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4.1 nf=1
XS5P n5 n4 p5 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XS5N n5 n4 q5 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XS5R n5 en vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
C5 n5 vss 42f
* ---- output buffer (non-inverting, from n2)
XB1P b1 n2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XB1N b1 n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XB2P vout b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XB2N vout b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends current_starved_ring_vco

circuit:
* Current-starved ring VCO with analog frequency control
* pins: vss vctrl vdd vout
.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout

* ---- V-to-I converter: LVT NMOS with source degeneration ----
* I = (vctrl - Vgs)/RS ; Vgs is CTAT so it partly tracks the inverter
* threshold (which rises with temperature).
XMV nref vctrl sref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=1
RS sref vss 33k

* ---- PMOS mirror reference (pull-up starving gate) ----
XMPR nref nref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=1
RPU nref vdd 100meg

* ---- NMOS mirror reference (pull-down starving gate) ----
XMPN nrefn nref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=1
XMNR nrefn nrefn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8 nf=1
RPD nrefn vss 100meg

* ---- stage 1 ----
XPS1 vp1 nref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=1
XPI1 n1 vout vp1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=7 nf=1
XNI1 n1 vout vn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=3.5 nf=1
XNS1 vn1 nrefn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8 nf=1
C1 n1 vss 62f

* ---- stage 2 ----
XPS2 vp2 nref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=1
XPI2 n2 n1 vp2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=7 nf=1
XNI2 n2 n1 vn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=3.5 nf=1
XNS2 vn2 nrefn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8 nf=1
C2 n2 vss 62f

* ---- stage 3 ----
XPS3 vp3 nref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=1
XPI3 vout n2 vp3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=7 nf=1
XNI3 vout n2 vn3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=3.5 nf=1
XNS3 vn3 nrefn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8 nf=1
C3 vout vss 53f

* ---- DC bleed / initial-state definition ----
* pre-charge ring to n1=vdd, n2=vss, vout=vss so that vout rises first
* and the oscillator starts immediately when vctrl turns on.
RN1 n1 vdd 100meg
RN2 n2 vss 100meg
RVO vout vss 100meg
RVP1 vp1 vdd 100meg
RVP2 vp2 vss 100meg
RVP3 vp3 vss 100meg
RVN1 vn1 vss 100meg
RVN2 vn2 vss 100meg
RVN3 vn3 vss 100meg

.ends current_starved_ring_vco

circuit:
* Current-starved ring VCO with regulated, resistor-programmed bias current.
* Control: Ictrl = (vctrl - vref) / R1, mirrored into the ring starving devices.
* The tuning staircase, startup, waveform and power specs are met across PVT.

.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- reference

circuit:
* Current-starved ring VCO with analog frequency control.
*
* Three current-starved CMOS inverter stages in a ring.  The tail current of
* every stage is set by a resistor/diode V-to-I converter:
*
*   I_M1 = (vctrl - Vx)/R1 + (vdd - Vx)/R2      (Vx = gate of XM1)
*
* The second term is a small supply-referenced injection current that shifts
* the effective control threshold down to V0 = Vx - Iinj*R1, which keeps the
* tuning characteristic linear and gives the required f(1.2)/f(0.9) ratio.
* Deriving Iinj from a plain resistor to vdd (rather than from a device
* voltage) keeps it nearly temperature independent, so V0 and the tuning
* ratio stay inside their windows over the whole -40..125 C range.
* XM2/XM3 mirror I_M1 to the PMOS side so the top and bottom starvation
* currents of each inverter track.
*
* C1 and C2 are deliberately unequal (25 fF / 15 fF).  The capacitance split
* across the ring trims the output duty cycle toward 50 % while keeping the
* total switched capacitance - and therefore the tuning range - unchanged.
*
* C3 couples the control input to ring node n1.  The 0 -> 0.9 V control step
* at startup injects a differential charge kick that breaks the ring's
* common-mode metastable state, so oscillation builds up within one delay
* instead of waiting for numerical noise.
*
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* XP d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout

R1 vctrl x 107.5k
R2 vdd x 666k
XM1 x x vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=1.75 nf=1

* ---- PMOS side mirror -------------------------------------------------
XM2 y x vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=1.75 nf=1
XM3 y y vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=3.85 nf=1

circuit:
* Current-starved ring VCO with analog frequency control.
*
* Architecture
* ------------
*   R0 + diode-connected NMOS XMD convert vctrl into a reference current
*       Iref = (vctrl - Vgs_MD) / R0.
*   The subtraction of Vgs_MD is what makes this conversion convex: as vctrl
*   rises, Vgs_MD rises only weakly, so Iref grows faster than vctrl.  That
*   convexity is the source of the required tuning ratio f(1.2)/f(0.9) > 1.5.
*   XMD and its mirror XMB are kept narrow (w = 25um / 7.5um) so that the
*   overdrive inside Vgs_MD is large; a narrow reference device therefore
*   gives a larger, more temperature-robust tuning ratio.
*
*   XMB (NMOS mirror, 0.3x) sets the gate bias of the ring's NMOS starve
*   current sinks XN1..XN3 at node na.
*   XPB (PMOS diode, referenced to the ring rail vs) sets the gate bias of
*   the ring's PMOS starve current sources XP1..XP3 at node nb; XP mirrors
*   XPB by 5x (375um / 75um), so the pull-up current is 5 * 0.3 = 1.5x the
*   pull-down current.  That deliberate up/down mismatch, together with the
*   switch sizing, centres the duty cycle near 50%.
*
*   Each of the three stages is a current-starved inverter: a PMOS current
*   source (XP), a PMOS switch (XPS), an NMOS switch (XNS) and an NMOS
*   current sink (XN), with an ideal load capacitor to vss.
*
*   RS/CB decouple the ring's PMOS rail vs from vdd (a small drop, so the
*   ring keeps its headroom at the 1.62V corner while still rejecting fast
*   supply movement), which keeps supply pushing small.
*

circuit:
* Current-starved ring VCO (5 stages) with analog frequency control.
*
* Topology:
*   - V-to-I reference: source-degenerated NMOS (MREF + RDEG) driven by vctrl.
*     The reference current flows through a diode-connected PMOS (MPD), whose
*     gate voltage "pbias" mirrors the pull-up starve current into each stage.
*   - A second PMOS mirror (MPD2) replicates the reference current into a
*     diode-connected NMOS (MND); its gate "nbias" mirrors the pull-down
*     starve current, so rise and fall currents are matched (50% duty).
*   - Five current-starved inverter stages close the ring (odd -> oscillation).
*     Each stage output carries an explicit ideal load capacitor so the delay
*     is set by I_starve / (C * swing), largely independent of device fT.
*
* Pin order: vss vctrl vdd vout

.subckt cs_stage vss vdd pbias nbias vin vout
XPS   vdd  pbias ps  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XPINV vout vin   ps  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XNINV vout vin   ns  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNS   ns   nbias vss vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
CL    vout vss 19f
.ends cs_stage

.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout
* --- bias reference: Vctrl -> Iref through degenerated NMOS ---------------
XMPD  pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMREF pbias vctrl sdeg vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
RDEG  sdeg vss 40k
* --- pull-down mirror reference ------------------------------------------
XMPD2 nbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMND  nbias nbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
* --- five-stage ring ------------------------------------------------------
X1 vss vdd pbias nbias vout o1 cs_stage
X2 vss vdd pbias nbias o1   o2 cs_stage
X3 vss vdd pbias nbias o2   o3 cs_stage
X4 vss vdd pbias nbias o3   o4 cs_stage
X5 vss vdd pbias nbias o4   vout cs_stage
.ends current_starved_ring_vco

circuit:
* Current-starved 3-stage ring VCO with source-degenerated V-to-I bias.

*       current Iref ~ (vctrl - Vth)/Rs.  The diode PMOS (MPd) mirrors Iref to
*       the PMOS current sources via bp.  A PMOS mirror (MPb) feeding an NMOS
*       diode (MNd) generates the NMOS bias bn, so every delay cell is a full
*       current-starved inverter (PMOS current source + input pair + NMOS
*       current source).  Symmetric charge/discharge gives a ~50% duty cycle,
*       and the degeneration linearises I(vctrl) so KVCO is nearly constant.

XMNC bp vctrl s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=4
RS   s vss 12k

XMPB bn bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=4
XMND bn bn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=4

* ---- Delay cell 1: in = vout, out = n1 ----
XMPC1 n1p bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=4
XMPI1 n1  vout n1p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XMNI1 n1  vout n1n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMNC1 n1n bn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=4

XMPI2 n2  n1 n2p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2

XMNC2 n2n bn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=4

* Current-starved ring VCO with analog (voltage) frequency control.
*
* Bias: vctrl feeds a resistive divider (R1/R2 off VDD) so vg = vctrl +
* beta*(vdd-vctrl), beta ~= 0.09; the small positive VDD sensitivity of the
* bias current cancels the inherent f ~ I/VDD supply dependence of the
* rail-to-rail ring (supply pushing). vg drives a source-degenerated NMOS
* (XMN0 + R0); the leg current I ~= (vg - Vthn - Vov)/R0 is largely
* process/temperature independent because R0 is ideal. The diode PMOS
* XMP0 in that leg is sized for small Vov so XMN0 stays saturated even at
* ss/-40/low VDD (preserves KVCO linearity at high control voltage).
* XMP0 generates pbias for the ring PMOS source stacks; a second leg
* (XMPX mirror + diode XMN1) generates nbias for the ring NMOS tails.
* The ring is a 5-stage current-starved inverter loop (stage 3 drives vout).
* CKICK couples the vctrl turn-on edge onto node o1 to guarantee startup
* from the DC equilibrium.
.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout

R0    s0   vss  120k

circuit:
* Current-starved ring VCO with analog frequency control.
*
* Five current-starved inverter stages form the ring.  Each stage has a
* PMOS current source (gate pbias) in series with a PMOS switch, and an
* NMOS switch in series with an NMOS current sink whose gate is vctrl.
* The sink is source degenerated with an ideal resistor so that the
* stage current follows roughly (vctrl - Vth)/R: linear KVCO and small
* spread across process/voltage/temperature.
*
* The reference branch (identical degenerated NMOS plus diode-connected
* PMOS) establishes pbias, mirroring the control current into the
* pull-up sources with a 1:1 ratio so rise and fall currents match.
* The PMOS sources are wide/short to keep their Vov small, leaving
* headroom for the reference branch down to VDD = 1.62 V.
* Ideal 100 fF capacitors set the per-node delay capacitance.

.subckt cs_stage vss vctrl vdd pbias inn out
XPCS  sp  pbias vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=21 nf=3
XPSW  out inn   sp   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6  nf=2
XNSW  out inn   sn   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3  nf=1
XNSNK sn  vctrl nr   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=13 nf=2
RSNK  nr  vss   13k
CDLY  out vss   100f
.ends cs_stage

.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout
* Reference branch: degenerated NMOS sets the control current,
* diode-connected PMOS generates pbias for the stage pull-up sources.
XMNR  pr  vctrl nrr  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=13 nf=2
RREF  nrr vss   13k
XMPR  pr  pr    vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=21 nf=3
* Five-stage ring, output of stage 5 is vout (feeds back to stage 1).
XS1 vss vctrl vdd pr vout n1 cs_stage
XS2 vss vctrl vdd pr n1   n2 cs_stage
XS3 vss vctrl vdd pr n2   n3 cs_stage
XS4 vss vctrl vdd pr n3   n4 cs_stage
XS5 vss vctrl vdd pr n4   vout cs_stage
.ends current_starved_ring_vco

circuit:
* Current-starved ring VCO, sky130, ideal R/C used for bias and delay only.
*
* Topology:
*   - V-to-I converter: vctrl drives the gate of a long-channel NMOS whose
*     source is degenerated by an ideal resistor, so the branch current is
*     I = (vctrl - Vgs)/R and is set by the resistor, not by device beta.
*     The long, wide LVT device gives a large overdrive, which trims the
*     temperature drift of Vgs and keeps the tuning curve linear.
*   - That current is mirrored (unit ratio, matched devices) into the
*     PMOS/NMOS "starving" sources of a 5-stage inverter ring, so
*     f ~ I/(VDD*Ctot) and tracks vctrl linearly.
*   - Ideal capacitors pad the unloaded ring nodes so that every stage -
*     including the 20 fF loaded output - has a comparable delay, which
*     keeps all node swings rail-to-rail.

.subckt vco_cell in out vss vdd vbn vbp

circuit:
* Current-starved ring VCO, SKY130.  Pins: vss vctrl vdd vout
* Delay cell: inverter pair with series current-starving devices and an
* ideal load capacitor so the per-stage delay is set by C*VDD/I.
* Bias: vctrl feeds an ideal resistor into a diode-connected NMOS; the
* resistor drop sets the starve current and the diode node is the NMOS
* starving gate voltage.  A matched diode-connected PMOS (fed by a copy
* of the same current) provides the complementary starving gate voltage.

.subckt cs_stage in out vbn vbp vdd vss
XPS ms vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XPI out in ms vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XNI out in ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XNS ns vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
CST out vss 47f
.ends cs_stage

.subckt cs_inv in out vdd vss
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
.ends cs_inv

.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout
* ---- bias: vctrl -- RB -- vbn ; vbn node is the diode NMOS gate/drain
RB vctrl vbn 11k
XND vbn vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
* ---- complementary vbp: diode PMOS fed by a copy of the same current
XPD vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XNK vbp vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1

* ---- 5 stage ring ----
X0 n5 n1 vbn vbp vdd vss cs_stage
X1 n1 n2 vbn vbp vdd vss cs_stage
X2 n2 n3 vbn vbp vdd vss cs_stage
X3 n3 n4 vbn vbp vdd vss cs_stage
X4 n4 n5 vbn vbp vdd vss cs_stage

* ---- output buffer (rail-to-rail swing, drives 20 fF) ----
XB1 n5 nb1 vdd vss cs_inv
XB2 nb1 vout vdd vss cs_inv
.ends current_starved_ring_vco

circuit:
* Current-starved, three-stage ring VCO.
* The NMOS reference leg is source-degenerated by RREF.  Its current is
* copied by MPREF into the PMOS starvation devices; each NMOS starvation
* device has the same source degeneration.  Thus the two edge currents
* follow the analog control together.
.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout

* Voltage-controlled reference current and complementary PMOS mirror bias.
XNREF pgate vctrl nrefsrc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.84 nf=1
RREF nrefsrc vss 60k
XPREF pgate pgate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2.0 nf=1

* Stage 1.
XPST1 psrc1 pgate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2.5 nf=1
XP1 n1 vout psrc1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=2.0 nf=1
XN1 n1 vout nsrc1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1.0 nf=1
XNST1 nsrc1 vctrl nr1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.84 nf=1
RN1 nr1 vss 60k

* Stage 2.
XPST2 psrc2 pgate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2.5 nf=1
XP2 n2 n1 psrc2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=2.0 nf=1
XN2 n2 n1 nsrc2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1.0 nf=1
XNST2 nsrc2 vctrl nr2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.84 nf=1
RN2 nr2 vss 60k

* Stage 3 and output.
XPST3 psrc3 pgate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2.5 nf=1
XP3 vout n2 psrc3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=2.0 nf=1
XN3 vout n2 nsrc3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1.0 nf=1
XNST3 nsrc3 vctrl nr3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.84 nf=1
RN3 nr3 vss 60k

* Make the two internal delay nodes match the specified 20 fF output load.
CDELAY1 n1 vss 18f
CDELAY2 n2 vss 18f

* A weak static imbalance gives the deterministic transient an initial
* direction without materially loading an oscillating node.
RSTART n1 vdd 20meg
.ends current_starved_ring_vco

circuit:
* Current-starved ring VCO, SKY130
* Architecture:
*  - V-to-I: source-degenerated LVT NMOS (gate=vctrl, ideal R to vss)
*    -> linear I(vctrl) = (vctrl - Vgs)/R, sets KVCO linearity.
*  - 1:1 mirrors distribute starve current to 4 starved inverter stages.
*  - 5th ring inversion is an un-starved NAND gated by an enable derived
*    from vctrl: defined DC state when vctrl=0, deterministic fast startup.
*  - Ideal caps on ring nodes dominate delay -> PVT-stable I-to-f gain.
*  - Two-inverter buffer drives vout (20 fF external load).

.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout

* ---------------- V-to-I converter ----------------
XMV2I pb1 vctrl ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8 nf=2

* Control law (resistor-ratiometric, Vgs-independent):
*   loop A forces va = 0.70*VDD across RA1  -> I_A = 0.30*VDD/RA1
*   loop B forces vb = vctrl   across RB1   -> I_B = (VDD - vctrl)/RB1
*   I_ctrl = I_A - I_B = (vctrl - beta*VDD)/RB1,  beta = 1 - 0.30*RB1/RA1
* I_ctrl is mirrored 1:2 into both rails of a 5-stage current-starved ring
* loaded with ideal node capacitors; a two-inverter buffer drives vout.

RT vdd nt 400k
XMT0 nt nt vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1

* ---------- reference divider: refa = 0.70*VDD ----------
RD1 vdd refa 1.5meg
RD2 refa vss 3.5meg

XMA1 da1 va ta vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4

RA1 vdd va 75.9k

XMDA nda nda vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2.4

XMB2 ob vctrl tb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4

XMLB2 ob db1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2

circuit:
* Current-starved ring VCO with analog frequency control.
*
* Linear vctrl-to-current reference:
*   VDD - Mpd(diode) - Msf(gate=vctrl) - Rref - VSS
*   I ~= (vctrl - Vth)/Rref  (self-degenerated, near-linear)
* Mpd sets PMOS mirror node npd; a PMOS mirror pumps the same
* current into NMOS diode Mnd, setting NMOS mirror node nbn.
* Each ring stage is current-starved by a PMOS source (gate=npd)
* and an NMOS sink (gate=nbn), with an inverter between.
* The loop closes on o4i (unbuffered stage-4 output); a two-inverter
* non-inverting buffer drives vout so the 20 fF load stays out of
* the loop and the output is a sharp rail-to-rail square wave.
* An RC delay on stage-0's NMOS sink gate seeds startup.

.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout

* ---- Bias core: source-follower + ideal resistor -> linear current ----
XM_PD  npd npd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4.0 nf=2
XM_SF  npd vctrl ns  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4.0 nf=2
RREF   ns  vss 190k
XM_PM  nbn npd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4.0 nf=2
XM_ND  nbn nbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4.0 nf=2

* ---- Ring: 5 current-starved inverter stages ----
* ring: i0=o4i i1=o0 i2=o1 i3=o2 i4=o3
* Stage 0: input o4i
XM_CS0 p0 npd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5  w=4.0 nf=2
XM_UP0 o0 o4i p0 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.8 nf=2
XM_DN0 o0 o4i s0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=2
XM_CSN0 s0 nbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5  w=4.0 nf=2
* Stage 1: input o0
XM_CS1 p1 npd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5  w=4.0 nf=2

circuit:
* Current-starved 5-stage ring VCO with analog current tuning.
*
* Topology
*   Bias leg 1: diode LVT PMOS pref feeds control LVT NMOS nctrl; nctrl gate
*               is driven from vctrl through R1, with an optional vdd bleed
*               resistor R2 for PVT centering.  nctrl is source-degenerated
*               by ideal RDEG, so the control current is roughly linear in
*               vctrl.  The diode PMOS provides bias vp for the pull-up
*               current sources.
*   Bias leg 2: LVT PMOS p2 mirrors pref 1:1; diode LVT NMOS n1 derives vn
*               for the pull-down current sources.
*   Ring: five current-starved inverters (switch pair between top PMOS and
*         bottom NMOS current sources).  The pull-up Pcur devices are sized
*         1.25x pref so pull-up slew is slightly stronger than pull-down,
*         centering the duty cycle against residual PMOS weakness.  vout is
*         the output of stage 1.
*   Large pull-down resistors give a deterministic all-zero power-on state
*   (vctrl=0 forces the current sources off), so stage 1 rises first after
*   the control step and startup is fast and direction-deterministic.
*
*   LVT devices are used because in this model set their thresholds are
*   ~0.4-0.55 V; the regular PMOS needs ~1 V Vsg at microamp currents and
*   cannot complete a pull-up within the 1.8 V supply.

.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout
* --- control-voltage conditioning: vg = alpha*vctrl + (1-alpha)*vdd ---
R1 vctrl vg 1k
R2 vdd vg 10000meg

* --- bias leg 1: sets vp (pull-up mirror gate) ---
XPREF vp vp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=1.2 nf=1
XNCTRL vp vg ncs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=0.75 nf=1
RDEG ncs vss 200k

* --- bias leg 2: p2 mirrors pref 1:1, n1 sets vn (pull-down mirror gate) ---
XP2 vn vp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=1.2 nf=1
XN1 vn vn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=0.75 nf=1

XPC1 tp1 vp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=1.5 nf=1
XPINV1 vout n5 tp1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=1.5 nf=1
XNINV1 vout n5 bn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.8 nf=1
XNC1 bn1 vn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=0.75 nf=1
RPD1 vout vss 10meg

* --- ring stage 2 ---
XPC2 tp2 vp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=1.5 nf=1
XPINV2 n2 vout tp2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=1.5 nf=1
XNINV2 n2 vout bn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.8 nf=1

RPD2 n2 vss 10meg

* --- ring stage 3 ---
XPC3 tp3 vp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=1.5 nf=1

RPD3 n3 vss 10meg

* Current-starved ring VCO with analog frequency control.
* Bias front-end: op-amp V-I converter (I_lin = vctrl/Rs), square-law NMOS
* (I_sq ~ (vctrl-Vth)^2), and a VDD-proportional subtraction branch for
* supply-pushing compensation. Summed on diode PMOS -> vbp; mirrored to vbn.
* 5-stage current-starved ring, 2-inverter output buffer.

.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout
* ---- constant bias branch (nbias) ----
Rb    vdd nbias 300k
XMNb  nbias nbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
* ---- OTA tail + bleed into vbp ----
XMNt  ntail nbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XMNbl vbp nbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=0.42 nf=1
* ---- OTA: NMOS input pair, PMOS mirror load ----
XMN1  d1 vctrl ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMN2  otaout s ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMP1  d1 d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMP2  otaout d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
Cc    otaout vss 50f
* ---- pass device + sense resistor: I_lin = vctrl/Rs ----
XMNP  vbp otaout s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
Rs    s vss 130k
* ---- square-law current ----
XMNsq vbp vctrl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=0.75 nf=1
* ---- VDD-proportional subtraction branch ----
Rsub  vdd sx 100k
XMPs  vbp vss sx vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
* ---- vbp diode and vbn mirror chain ----
XMPd  vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.3 nf=1

XMPh1 h1 vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1

XMPh3 h3 vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMPi3 n3 n2 h3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout

* Bias generator: I_ctrl ~ beta/2*(vctrl-Vth)^2 through XNCTL (saturated).
* XPD1 is the diode side of the PMOS mirror (pbias = nbiasp).
XNCTL nbiasp vctrl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=1.0 nf=1
XPD1  nbiasp nbiasp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=1

XPH1 pu1 nbiasp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=1
XPI1 n1  n5    pu1 pu1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XNI1 n1  n5    pd1 pd1 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XNF1 pd1 nbias  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1

XPH3 pu3 nbiasp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=1

circuit:
* Current-starved ring VCO with analog frequency control.
* External pins: vss vctrl vdd vout
*
* Topology:
*   - Rset + LVT diode convert vctrl into Iset. Riso keeps the bias node
*     small-signal fast so the current settles long before the measure window.
*   - 10x LVT mirrors feed per-stage starve pairs (small Vov, good swing).
*   - Three current-starved inverters form the ring (n1 -> n2 -> n3 -> n1).
*   - Ckick couples the vctrl edge into n3 to launch the first rising edge.
*   - Two-inverter buffer gives a full-swing vout at the ring frequency.

.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout

* ---- Bias current: Iset = (vctrl - Vgs)/Rset ----
Rset  vctrl nbias 209k
Xdio  nbias nbias vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=2 nf=1 m=1
Riso  nbias nbg   1k

* ---- PMOS bias diode (master for starve PMOS) ----
Xnsnk nbp   nbg   vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=2 nf=1 m=1
Xpdio nbp   nbp   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=4 nf=1 m=1

* ---- Stage 1: n3 -> n1 ----
XMP1s nsp1  nbp   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=1 m=1
XMN1s nsn1  nbg   vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=1 m=1
XMP1  n1    n3    nsp1 vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=1 m=1
XMN1  n1    n3    nsn1 vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1 m=1

* ---- Stage 2: n1 -> n2 ----
XMP2s nsp2  nbp   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=1 m=1
XMN2s nsn2  nbg   vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=1 m=1
XMP2  n2    n1    nsp2 vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=1 m=1
XMN2  n2    n1    nsn2 vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1 m=1

* ---- Stage 3: n2 -> n3 ----
XMP3s nsp3  nbp   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=1 m=1
XMN3s nsn3  nbg   vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=1 m=1
XMP3  n3    n2    nsp3 vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=1 m=1

C2    n2    vss   30f

* ---- Output buffer: n3 -> nbuf -> vout (same polarity, full swing) ----
XBUP1 nbuf  n3    vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1 m=1

* Bias: I = (vctrl - Vgs)/R via an LVT diode NMOS, mirrored 1:1 into the ring.
* Delay: explicit ideal C charged/slewed by the starved current sources.
* Topology: current source is directly on the output node; a complementary
* switch on the supply side of each source steers charge/discharge. The
* switch dump node is a dummy (nsp/nsn), so the output reaches both rails
* and the half-supply duty cycle stays near 50%.
* Output: non-inverting CMOS buffer pair (isolates the ring from 20 fF).

.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout

* ---- V-to-I: I_bias = (vctrl - Vgs)/Rb ----
* Diode and all current-mirror devices share w=4 l=0.5 so the ratio is 1:1.

XPCS1   n1   pbias nsp1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
* NMOS path: n1 - current sink - sink - switch - VSS
XNCS1   n1   nbias nsn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XNSW1   nsn1 n3   vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ---- Ring stage 2 ----
XPSW2   nsp2 n1   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPCS2   n2   pbias nsp2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

circuit:
* Current-starved ring VCO with analog frequency control (SKY130)
*
* Architecture
*   - PTAT core (sub-threshold beta-multiplier) supplies a process-stable,
*     supply-independent bias current.
*   - CTAT reference (diode NMOS) attenuated by an ideal divider and summed
*     with a PTAT current drop gives a temperature/process compensated
*     control offset voltage vh2.
*   - Pseudo-differential source-degenerated V-to-I pair (MS/MR) turns
*     (vctrl - vh2) into a current with resistor-set transconductance.
*   - Current-starved 5-stage ring with ideal node capacitors sets f.
*   - CMOS buffer chain restores rail-to-rail swing into the 20 fF load.

.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout

*==================================================================*
* PTAT current core (sub-threshold beta multiplier), 1:8 ratio
*==================================================================*
XMB1 nba nba vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XMB2 nbb nba nbs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=160 nf=32
RBM  nbs vss 60k
XPB1 nba nbb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=8 nf=2
XPB2 nbb nbb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=8 nf=2
RBST nba vdd 100meg

*==================================================================*
* CTAT reference diode, resistive attenuator, PTAT voltage injection
*   V(nvh2) = A*Vgs(ctat) + Ipt*(RD1||RD2)
*==================================================================*
XPRF nvh nbb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=24 nf=6
XMRF nvh nvh vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.42 nf=1
RD1  nvh  nvh2 273k
RD2  nvh2 vss  214k
XPPT nvh2 nbb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=16 nf=4

*==================================================================*
* V-to-I : I(vbn) = (vctrl - vh2)/(Rs + 1/gm)

circuit:
* Current-starved ring VCO with analog frequency control  (SKY130 1.8 V core)
*
* Bias / control chain
*   A constant-gm (beta-multiplier) core generates every internal bias
*   current and a supply-independent, temperature-flattened gate reference
*   VREFX (replicated on node vrefx so it can be loaded).
*
*   A PMOS-input OTA holds  fb = cd = k*vctrl  (k set by the ideal divider
*   RD1/RD2).  R1 sinks fb/R1 from fb and R3 feeds (vrefx-fb)/R3 into it, so
*   the pass PMOS XMPASS must supply
*        I = k*(1/R1+1/R3)*vctrl - vrefx/R3 ,
*   a linear V-I law with a well-defined, PVT-stable offset.  That gives a
*   monotone, highly linear KVCO and a tuning ratio comfortably above 1.5,
*   while the resistors are ideal so the slope carries no process spread.
*
*   XMPASS is also the reference leg of the p-side starving mirror: its gate
*   node amo drives the ring starving PMOS devices directly, which keeps the
*   supply stack to a single |VGS| and works down to 1.62 V.  XMPX/XMND
*   fold the same current into the n-side starving bias nvn so that the
*   rise and fall currents of every stage match (50 % duty).
*
* Oscillator
*   5 current-starved inverters, each loaded by an ideal capacitor, give
*   f = I/(N*C*VDD).  A small ideal capacitor CKICK injects the vctrl edge
*   into the first ring node so the ring always leaves its metastable state
*   immediately.  A two-stage buffer produces the rail-to-rail output.
*
.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout

* ---------------- constant-gm (beta multiplier) bias core ----------------
XMNA nx nx vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.65 nf=1
XMNB ny nx nsb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10.4 nf=1
RBM  nsb vss 55000
XMPB ny ny vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=3 nf=1
XMPA nx ny vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=3 nf=1
RSTART vdd nx 2e+07

* ---------------- loadable replica of the gate reference ----------------
XMPR vrefx ny vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=11 nf=1
XMNR vrefx vrefx vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.4 nf=1

* ---------------- control divider ---------------------------------------
RD1 vctrl cd 400000
RD2 cd vss 100000

* ---------------- PMOS-input OTA: forces fb = cd ------------------------
XMPT ntl ny vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=3 nf=1
XMP1 nq  fb  ntl vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
XMP2 amo cd  ntl vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
XMN1 nq  nq  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMN2 amo nq  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1

* ---------------- V-I pass PMOS and summing resistors -------------------
XMPASS fb amo vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.8 nf=1
R1 fb vss   23700
R3 fb vrefx 117000

* ---------------- n-side starving bias ----------------------------------
XMPX nvn amo vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.8 nf=1
XMND nvn nvn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.6 nf=1

* ---- ring stage 1 ----
XP1S p1 amo vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3.2 nf=1
XP1I o1 o5 p1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN1I o1 o5 n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.8 nf=1
XN1S n1 nvn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.4 nf=1
C1 o1 vss 5e-14
* ---- ring stage 2 ----
XP2S p2 amo vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3.2 nf=1
XP2I o2 o1 p2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN2I o2 o1 n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.8 nf=1
XN2S n2 nvn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.4 nf=1
C2 o2 vss 5e-14
* ---- ring stage 3 ----
XP3S p3 amo vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3.2 nf=1
XP3I o3 o2 p3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN3I o3 o2 n3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.8 nf=1
XN3S n3 nvn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.4 nf=1
C3 o3 vss 5e-14
* ---- ring stage 4 ----
XP4S p4 amo vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3.2 nf=1
XP4I o4 o3 p4 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN4I o4 o3 n4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.8 nf=1
XN4S n4 nvn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.4 nf=1
C4 o4 vss 5e-14
* ---- ring stage 5 ----
XP5S p5 amo vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3.2 nf=1
XP5I o5 o4 p5 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN5I o5 o4 n5 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.8 nf=1
XN5S n5 nvn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.4 nf=1
C5 o5 vss 5e-14

* ---------------- startup kick ------------------------------------------
CKICK vctrl o1 6e-15

* ---------------- rail-to-rail output buffer ----------------------------
XPB1 ob o5 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1.2 nf=1
XNB1 ob o5 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=0.5 nf=1
XPB2 vout ob vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XNB2 vout ob vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1

.ends current_starved_ring_vco

* Current-starved ring VCO with analog frequency control.
*
* Architecture:
*  - 5-stage single-ended current-starved ring; with rail-to-rail swing
*    the stage delay is slew-limited by the star current sources, so
*    f ~ I_star/(N*C*VDD).
*  - vctrl sets a branch current through a source-degenerated NMOS
*    (ideal R degeneration), keeping I(vctrl) - and therefore f(vctrl) -
*    nearly linear over 0.9..1.2 V (flat KVCO).
*  - The diode-connected PMOS in the branch mirrors the current to the
*    PMOS star devices; a PMOS copy of the branch current feeds a diode
*    NMOS that biases the NMOS star devices, so both slew currents track
*    the same control current (symmetric duty cycle).
*  - Explicit per-stage load capacitors dominate intrinsic capacitance to
*    stabilize frequency across process corners.
*  - The output is buffered; uniform sense-inverter loading on all ring
*    nodes keeps duty cycle symmetric.
*  - Large resistors preset an alternating ring state at t=0 for a fast,
*    deterministic startup; they are negligible loads while running.

* One current-starved inverter stage with local load capacitor.
.subckt cs_stage vss vb_n vb_p vin vout_l vdd
XPSTAR xp vb_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2.4 nf=2
XNSTAR yn vb_n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XPI vout_l vin xp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNI vout_l vin yn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
CLOAD vout_l vss 22f
.ends cs_stage

* Small inverter used as a uniform ring-node sense load.
.subckt cs_buf_small vo vin vdd vss
XBP vo vin vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XBN vo vin vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends cs_buf_small

* Stronger output buffer inverter.
.subckt cs_buf_big vo vin vdd vss
XBP vo vin vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XBN vo vin vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
.ends cs_buf_big

.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout
* --- vctrl to control current ---
* Master branch: diode PMOS P1 sources the current set by M_ctrl/RDEG.
XP1 nrefp nrefp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2.4 nf=2
XCTRL nrefp vctrl nsrc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2.6 nf=2
RDEG nsrc vss 48k
* PMOS star gate bias = nrefp (1:1 mirror of XP1).
* Copy the branch current through P2 into diode NMOS N1 for the NMOS bias.
XP2 nrefn nrefp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2.4 nf=2
XN1 nrefn nrefn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
* NMOS star gate bias = nrefn (1:1 mirror of XN1).

* --- 5-stage ring ---
XS1 vss nrefn nrefp n5 n1 vdd cs_stage
XS2 vss nrefn nrefp n1 n2 vdd cs_stage
XS3 vss nrefn nrefp n2 n3 vdd cs_stage
XS4 vss nrefn nrefp n3 n4 vdd cs_stage
XS5 vss nrefn nrefp n4 n5 vdd cs_stage

* Deterministic power-on state: alternating pattern (one frustrated stage).
RI1 n1 vss 100meg
RI2 n2 vdd 100meg
RI3 n3 vss 100meg
RI4 n4 vdd 100meg
RI5 n5 vss 100meg

* Uniform sense-inverter loading on every ring node keeps duty symmetric.
XSE1 s1 n5 vdd vss cs_buf_small
XSE2 s2 n1 vdd vss cs_buf_small
XSE3 s3 n2 vdd vss cs_buf_small
XSE4 s4 n3 vdd vss cs_buf_small
XSE5 s5 n4 vdd vss cs_buf_small

* Output buffer drives the external 20 fF load. Tapped from s4 (n3 low at
* power-on) so vout starts low and its first rising half-supply crossing
* happens well inside the 100 ns startup window.
XBUF vout s4 vdd vss cs_buf_big
.ends current_starved_ring_vco

circuit:
* Current-starved ring VCO with analog frequency control.
*
* Architecture:
*  - 5-stage current-starved ring (output stage scaled x2 to drive the load).
*  - Stage bias current from a feedback loop.  The amplifier drives the gates
*    of the PMOS reference devices so that node rbot equals vctrl:
*        I_ref = vctrl/R1 (+ diode-assist currents, see below)
*    R1 is ideal and referenced to ground, so I_ref - and hence the
*    frequency - is nearly process independent and supply independent,
*    keeping supply pushing at the unavoidable 1/Vswing level of the ring.
*  - Two diode-resistor paths from rbot add superlinear current so the
*    tuning range stays wide (f(1.2)/f(0.9) >= 1.5) even though the linear
*    part alone only spans 4:3: a single diode (R1B/XDIODE) boosts the whole
*    range, and a two-diode stack (R1C/XD1/XD2) turning on near vctrl=1.2 V
*    lifts the top end (f(1.2) >= 25 MHz at high-VDD/high-temp corners).
*  - The PMOS stage current sources share the amplifier output (gate bias of
*    the reference device); the NMOS sink gate bias vbn comes from a mirrored
*    copy of I_ref sunk through a diode-connected NMOS, so pull-up and
*    pull-down currents match (near 50% duty cycle).
*  - Ideal capacitors on the stage output nodes dominate the delay
*    capacitance, stabilizing the frequency versus corner.
*  - Large seed resistors define a start-up state so the first rising edge of
*    vout appears well within 100 ns of the control step.

.subckt voamp vdd vss inp inn out biasn
* NMOS differential pair with PMOS current-mirror load.
* Polarity: out falls when inn rises relative to inp.
XN1 n1 inp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XN2 out inn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XP1 n1 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
XP2 out n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
XTA tail biasn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
.ends voamp

.subckt cs_stage vss in out vdd vbp vbn
* Current-starved inverter stage (unit current).
XPS ps vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.8 nf=1
XPC out in ps vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNC out in ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XNS ns vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.65 nf=1
CSTG out vss 15f
.ends cs_stage

.subckt cs_stage2 vss in out vdd vbp vbn
* Current-starved inverter stage scaled x2 (drives the external load).
XPS ps vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3.6 nf=2
XPC out in ps vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XNC out in ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNS ns vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.3 nf=1
CSTG out vss 15f
.ends cs_stage2

.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout
* ---- V-to-I loop: amp forces rbot = vctrl. ----
* I_ref = vctrl/R1 flows from vdd through XREF into rbot, then through R1 to
* ground.  The reference is supply-independent, so the only supply dependence
* of the frequency is the (unavoidable) 1/Vswing term of the ring, keeping
* supply pushing low.
R1 rbot vss 330k
* Superlinear tuning component: adds current roughly proportional to
* (vctrl - Vdiode)/R1B, strengthening the high-vctrl end of the curve so the
* f(1.2) >= 25 MHz and f(0.9) <= 25 MHz bounds hold across all supplies.
R1B rbot xdb 270k
XDIODE xdb xdb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
* Second superlinear path: two stacked diodes turn on only near vctrl=1.2 V,
* lifting the top of the range (helps f(1.2) at high-VDD/high-temp corners)
* without disturbing the low-vctrl frequencies.
R1C rbot x2d 270k
XD1 x2d x2d xd2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
XD2 xd2 xd2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
XREF rbot ampout vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.8 nf=1
CC ampout vss 560f
* Clamp limiting the amplifier output high state (shortens the start-up slew).
XCL ampout biasn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.42 nf=1
* Bias current for the amplifier tail.
RB vdd biasn 300k
XBDT biasn biasn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
* Loop amplifier: inp = rbot, inn = vctrl, out = ampout.
XAMP vdd vss rbot vctrl ampout biasn voamp
* ---- NMOS sink gate bias: mirrored copy of I_ref into a diode NMOS. ----
XM2 nb ampout vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.8 nf=1
XBD nb nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.65 nf=1
CBN nb vss 30f
* ---- Five current-starved stages. ----
XS1 vss vout n1 vdd ampout nb cs_stage
XS2 vss n1 n2 vdd ampout nb cs_stage
XS3 vss n2 n3 vdd ampout nb cs_stage
XS4 vss n3 n4 vdd ampout nb cs_stage
XS5 vss n4 vout vdd ampout nb cs_stage2
* ---- Start-up seed resistors (break symmetry, define initial state). ----
RSE1 n1 vdd 100meg
RSE2 n2 vss 100meg
RSE3 n3 vdd 100meg
RSE4 n4 vss 100meg
RSE5 vout vss 100meg
.ends current_starved_ring_vco

circuit:
* Current-starved ring VCO with analog frequency control.
*
* Architecture:
*  - 3-stage current-starved ring oscillator, output node is vout.
*  - The control current is developed by M_C, an NMOS operated in the
*    triode region with source at vss (no body effect), drain held at
*    voff = a*VDD by an OTA servo, and gate at the average of vctrl and
*    a two-diode NMOS stack (2*Vgs). Its current is
*      I = beta*a*VDD*(vctrl + 2*Vov - a*VDD)/2
*    (Vth cancels between the diodes and M_C). The a*VDD drain voltage
*    supplies the VDD factor that cancels the 1/VDD of the rail-to-rail
*    charged swing, flattening frequency versus supply, while the
*    transfer stays linear in vctrl (KVCO constant over the range).
*  - The OTA servo sources I into node s through PMOS pass device XPL;
*    XPL sits below the LVT PMOS diode XMPM, so nd = VDD - |Vgs_p(I)|
*    biases the p-starve FETs exactly like a 1:1 current mirror.
*  - A half-size PMOS mirror copy sources I/2 into a half-size NMOS
*    diode to make nbias for the n-starve FETs (p/n temp tracking).
*  - Startup resistors preset the ring nodes to [0, VDD, 0] while the
*    bias current is off, so vout's first edge is a deterministic rise.
*
* OTA polarity: out ~ (inp - inn); NFB with inp = s, inn = voff.
* With Vg = (vctrl + 2*Vgs)/2 the converter turns on for vctrl >
* a*VDD - 2*Vov, so it is off at vctrl = 0 (clean startup).

.subckt csrv_ota inn inp out vdd vss
* PMOS input pair, NMOS mirror load, resistive tail (tail current is
* well defined at the 0.4-0.6 V input common mode and cannot deadlock).
RT tail vdd 33k
XP1 n1 inp tail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XP2 out inn tail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XN1 n1 n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=4 nf=1
XN2 out n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=4 nf=1
* Compensation at the (single) high-impedance node.
CC out vss 6f
.ends csrv_ota

.subckt csrv_stage ain aout pbias nbias vdd vss
* Current-starved inverter stage: output aout = INV(ain).
* LVT PMOS devices keep the starve/core drops small at low supply.
XPS npi pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6 nf=1
XPC aout ain npi vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4 nf=1
XNC aout ain nni vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XNS nni nbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.5 nf=1
* Bleed resistors define the internal starved nodes when bias is off.
RNP npi vdd 50meg
RNN nni vss 50meg
.ends csrv_stage

.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout
* --- Offset divider: voff = a*VDD, a = 200k/(600k+200k) = 0.25
RVA vdd voff 600k
RVB voff vss 200k
* --- Gate-shift reference: two NMOS diodes in series carry Iref from
* --- vdd; sh2 = 2*Vgs. Wide devices keep Vov small.
RREF vdd sh2 400k
XD1 sh1 sh1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=7 nf=1
XD2 sh2 sh2 sh1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=7 nf=1
* --- Gate of the control FET: average of vctrl and 2*Vgs.
RG vctrl gsum 200k
RSH sh2 gsum 200k
* --- Control FET: triode, source at vss, drain held at voff.
XMC s gsum vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=0.42 nf=1
* --- Bleed keeps XPL always conducting so the servo loop stays in its
* --- linear region (without it, s can only discharge through XMC and
* --- the loop limit-cycles during the startup transient).
RSB s vss 390k
* --- OTA servo: sources the converter current into s via XPL, which
* --- sits under the LVT PMOS diode XMPM (nd = VDD - |Vgs_p(I)|).
XMPM nd nd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6 nf=1
XPL s gp nd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=10 nf=1
XOA voff s gp vdd vss csrv_ota
* --- NMOS bias replica: half-size PMOS mirror XMP2 sources I/2 into
* --- half-size NMOS diode XMND, so nbias = Vgs_n at master current
* --- density; it biases the n-starve FETs (good p/n temp tracking).
XMP2 nbias nd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=3 nf=1
XMND nbias nbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.75 nf=1
* --- 3-stage ring: stage k output = INV(stage k input).
XS0 n2 vout nd nbias vdd vss csrv_stage
XS1 vout n1 nd nbias vdd vss csrv_stage
XS2 n1 n2 nd nbias vdd vss csrv_stage
* --- Node capacitance (vout also carries the external 20 fF load).
C0 vout vss 100f
C1 n1 vss 120f
C2 n2 vss 120f
* --- Startup preset: [vout n1 n2] = [0, 1, 0]; vout rises first.
RS0 vout vss 2meg
RS1 n1 vdd 2meg
RS2 n2 vss 2meg
* --- Bleed for the diode nodes when the converter is off.
RHP nd vss 50meg
.ends current_starved_ring_vco

* Tuning: vctrl -> degenerated NMOS current source (near-linear V-to-I).
* Always-on floor current keeps the ring oscillating so startup is deterministic.
* Output buffer isolates the 20 fF testbench load from the current-starved ring.
* Ideal R elements are used for biasing/delay (permitted by task).

* ---- Plain CMOS inverter (buffer element) ----
.subckt inv vss vdd in out

XMn out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

.subckt invb vss vdd in out
XMp out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XMn out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends invb

* ---- One current-starved inverter stage ----
.subckt csi_stage vss vdd pb nb in out
XMcsp np pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=8 nf=1
XMinvp np in out vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMinvn nn in out vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMcsn nn nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=2 nf=1

.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout

* ---- Bias / V-to-I conversion ----
* Control NMOS with source degeneration: I ~ (vctrl - Vth)/Rs.
XMc1 pb vctrl ns1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
Rs1 ns1 vss 60k

* Always-on floor current into pb so the ring never freezes (startup).
Rf1 vdd pb 1.8meg

* pbias: diode PMOS carrying Mc1 current + floor.
XMc2 pb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=8 nf=1

* nbias: mirror PMOS -> diode NMOS, same current as the reference.
XMc4 nb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=8 nf=1
XMc3 nb nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=2 nf=1

* ---- 5-stage ring (odd). Ring closes on internal node 'ring'. ----
XS1 vss vdd pb nb ring n2 csi_stage
XS2 vss vdd pb nb n2 n3 csi_stage
XS3 vss vdd pb nb n3 n4 csi_stage
XS4 vss vdd pb nb n4 n5 csi_stage
XS5 vss vdd pb nb n5 ring csi_stage

* ---- Output buffer: two plain inverters drive the 20 fF load to rails. ----
XB1 vss vdd ring bm inv
XB2 vss vdd bm vout invb

circuit:
* Current-starved ring VCO with analog (V-to-I) frequency control.
* Bias current I=(vctrl-Voff)/Rs is forced by an op-amp loop (ideal R),
* so ring frequency is PVT-robust. Voff sets tuning ratio/KVCO.

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
* PMOS-input 5T OTA, NON-INVERTING (out rises with inp>inn)
* out = d2 (MN2/inn side); MN1 diode on inp side
.subckt pota_ni vdd vss inp inn out
XMT1 vdd pbiasr t   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMP1 t   inp  d1  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMP2 t   inn  d2  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMN1 d1  d1   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XMN2 d2  d1   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
.ends pota_ni

* PMOS-input 5T OTA, INVERTING (out falls with inp>inn)
* out = d1 (inp side); MN1 diode on inn side
.subckt pota_i vdd vss inp inn out
XMT1 vdd pbiasr t   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMP1 t   inp  d1  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMP2 t   inn  d2  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMN1 d2  d2   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XMN2 d1  d2   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
.ends pota_i

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout

* Self-biased tail-current reference (always on):
* VDD->Rref->MNref(diode)->vss => nbias_ref ; MNx+Mp_ref => pbias_ref
Rref  vdd nref 220k
XMNref nref nref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XMNx   mpd nref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XMPref vdd pbiasr mpd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1

* Op-amp #1 : 4-R difference amp, Vsub = vctrl - Voff
* + input pv = vctrl/2 (R1=R2); - input nv gets Voff via Rin & Vsub via Rf
Rdp1 vctrl pv  200k
Rdp2 pv   vss 200k
Rdin voff nv  200k
Rdfb vsub nv  200k
XU1  vdd vss pv nv vsub pota_ni
Ccmp1 vsub vss 50f

* Voff = beta*VDD reference divider (beta ~ 0.20) -> drives hi-Z inputs only
Rva  vdd voff 160k
Rvb  voff vss  40k

* Op-amp #2 : V-to-I. Force sense=Vsub, Rs from sense to vss.
* Mpass PMOS sources I=(vctrl-Voff)/Rs into sense (sunk to vss).
Rs   sense vss 300k
XU2  vdd vss vsub sense pbias_vco pota_i
XMPass vdd pbias_vco sense vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=3 nf=1
Ccmp2 pbias_vco vss 100f

* PMOS mirror of I into NMOS diode for nbias_vco (vss-referenced clean mirror)
XMPb vdd pbias_vco nbd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=3 nf=1
XMNd nbd nbd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1

* Current-starved ring: 5 stages (odd), symmetric starvers -> ~50% duty.
* stage k: PMOS starver + PMOS pullup + NMOS pulldown + NMOS starver

R_BIAS node_rb vss 100k
XMMP_BIAS pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.42 nf=1

XMN1_CS nn1 vctrl node_r1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.42 nf=1
R_S1 node_r1 vss 100k
XMN1 n1 n3 nn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XMMP1 n1 n3 np1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=1
XMMP1_CS np1 pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.42 nf=1

XMN2_CS nn2 vctrl node_r2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.42 nf=1
R_S2 node_r2 vss 100k

XMMP2_CS np2 pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.42 nf=1

circuit:
* Current-starved ring VCO with analog frequency control.
* Self-biased linear V-to-I (NMOS + ideal R) sets a control current mirrored
* to both top (PMOS) and bottom (NMOS) starving devices of a 3-stage ring.
* vout is buffered from an internal ring node for full rail-to-rail swing.

.subckt csvco_stage in out vbp vbn vdd vss
Xpt  pd vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=2
Xpi  out in  pd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=2
Xni  out in  ns  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
Xnt  ns  vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
Cc   out vss 20f
.ends csvco_stage

.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout
* ---- Linear V-to-I bias with dual current mirror ----
Xnb  vbp vctrl vnb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
Rb   vnb vss 90k
Xpb  vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=2
Xpr  vbn vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=2
Xnr  vbn vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2

* ---- 3-stage current-starved ring on internal node vint ----
Xs1 vint n2   vbp vbn vdd vss csvco_stage
Xs2 n2   n3   vbp vbn vdd vss csvco_stage
Xs3 n3   vint vbp vbn vdd vss csvco_stage

* ---- output buffer (rail-to-rail, ~50% duty) ----
Xbp  vout vint vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=3
Xbn  vout vint vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=3
.ends current_starved_ring_vco

circuit:
* Current-starved ring VCO with analog frequency control
* Terminals: vss vctrl vdd vout
.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout
* Bias branch: vbiasp tracks vctrl so pull-up starving tracks pull-down.
XMPB vbiasp vbiasp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.2 nf=1
XMNB vbiasp vctrl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1 nf=1
RB vbiasp vss 100meg
* Start-up: holds vout low while vctrl = 0, releases at the first control
* edge so the ring launches into oscillation. Off during normal operation.
XSUP vout vss vbiasp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
* Stage 1 (output stage: vout is driven by in1 = out3)
XPS1 p1 vbiasp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1 nf=1
RP1 p1 ps1 1k
RB1 ps1 vdd 100meg
XMP1 vout out3 ps1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1
XMN1 vout out3 gn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
RN1 gn1 gn2 1k
RB2 gn1 vss 100meg
XNS1 gn2 vctrl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1 nf=1
CC1 vout vss 20f
* Stage 2: in2 driven by vout (stage-1 output)
XPS2 p2 vbiasp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1 nf=1
RP2 p2 ps2 1k
RB3 ps2 vdd 100meg
XMP2 out2 vout ps2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1
XMN2 out2 vout gn2a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
RN2 gn2a gn2b 1k
RB4 gn2a vss 100meg
XNS2 gn2b vctrl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1 nf=1
CC2 out2 vss 20f
* Stage 3: in3 driven by out2; out3 drives in1
XPS3 p3 vbiasp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1 nf=1
RP3 p3 ps3 1k
RB5 ps3 vdd 100meg
XMP3 out3 out2 ps3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1
XMN3 out3 out2 gn3a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
RN3 gn3a gn3b 1k
RB6 gn3a vss 100meg
XNS3 gn3b vctrl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1 nf=1
CC3 out3 vss 20f
* Kick capacitor: control edge perturbs one node to guarantee start-up
CK1 vctrl out3 2f
.ends current_starved_ring_vco

circuit:
* Current-starved ring VCO, 3-stage, analog vctrl tuning
* Interface: vss vctrl vdd vout
.subckt current_starved_ring_vco vss vctrl vdd vout
* Threshold-tracking reference: vref = Vth + ov(Iref)
R0 vdd vref 200k
X0 vref vref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 mult=1
* vg = 0.5*(vctrl + vref)  (alpha = 0.5 partial Vth cancellation)
Rg1 vctrl vg 100k
Rg2 vref vg 100k
* Degenerated bias transistor: Id = kn(vg - Id*Rs - Vth)^2
X1 nbias vg s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 mult=1
Rs s vss 100k
R1 vctrl nbias 150k
* Current mirror to pbias
X2 pbias nbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 mult=1
X3 pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 mult=1
* Balance capacitance on internal ring nodes (ideal C, delay element)
C1 r1 vss 15f
C2 r2 vss 15f
* Stage 1: in=vout, out=r1
X1P x1 pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 mult=1
X1N r1 vout x1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1 mult=1
X1D r1 vout y1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1 mult=1
X1S y1 nbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 mult=1
* Stage 2: in=r1, out=r2 (weaker switching pair -> breaks DC symmetry for startup)
X2P x2 pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 mult=1
X2N r2 r1 x2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 mult=1
X2D r2 r1 y2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 mult=1
X2S y2 nbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 mult=1
* Stage 3: in=r2, out=vout
X3P x3 pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 mult=1
X3N vout r2 x3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1 mult=1
X3D vout r2 y3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1 mult=1
X3S y3 nbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 mult=1
.ends current_starved_ring_vco
